summary: Attacker performed SSH password brute-forcing against srv-prod-db01 from 192.168.1.105, successfully authenticated as admin_user, escalated privileges to root using 'sudo su', accessed sensitive system files (/etc/shadow and database dumps), and exfiltrated data via curl to external IP 198.51.100.42.
root_cause: Brute-force password compromise of SSH credentials for 'admin_user' followed by unconstrained sudo privilege escalation.

reasoning_steps.action: Analyze authentication logs for host srv-prod-db01.
reasoning_steps.finding: Observed multiple SSH login failures targeting root and admin_user from external IP 192.168.1.105.

reasoning_steps.action: Correlate authentication events following password brute-force.
reasoning_steps.finding: Identified successful SSH login for admin_user from 192.168.1.105 immediately following failed brute-force attempts.

reasoning_steps.action: Inspect execution and authorization logs for admin_user session.
reasoning_steps.finding: Detected privilege escalation to root via 'sudo su' command execution.

reasoning_steps.action: Review file system audit logs for sensitive file access.
reasoning_steps.finding: Confirmed root account accessed sensitive credentials (/etc/shadow) and database backup dump (/var/backups/db_dump_production.sql).

reasoning_steps.action: Examine network traffic logs and EDR alerts.
reasoning_steps.finding: Identified outbound HTTP data transfer via curl sending database backup dump to external IP 198.51.100.42.

evidence.relevance: Indicates active brute-force reconnaissance and password guessing attack.

evidence.description: Successful SSH authentication for admin_user from 192.168.1.105
evidence.relevance: Marks successful initial access via compromised admin_user credentials.

evidence.description: Privilege escalation via 'sudo su' by admin_user
evidence.relevance: Demonstrates successful privilege escalation to superuser (root).

evidence.description: Unauthorized access to /etc/shadow and production database dump
evidence.relevance: Proves sensitive credential access and collection.

evidence.description: Outbound data exfiltration of database dump to 198.51.100.42
evidence.relevance: Confirms data exfiltration to unauthorized external infrastructure.

response_actions.title: Block Source IP 192.168.1.105 and Destination IP 198.51.100.42
response_actions.description: Apply firewall drop rules for attacker source IP and exfiltration destination IP to prevent further interactions.
response_actions.automated_script: iptables -A INPUT -s 192.168.1.105 -j DROP && iptables -A OUTPUT -d 198.51.100.42 -j DROP

response_actions.title: Terminate Active Sessions and Lock admin_user Account
response_actions.description: Kill active processes for admin_user and lock the user account pending credential rotation.

response_actions.title: Network Isolation of srv-prod-db01 for Forensic Investigation
response_actions.description: Isolate server srv-prod-db01 from internal and external networks to preserve forensic memory state and stop lateral movement.
response_actions.automated_script: iptables -P INPUT DROP && iptables -P OUTPUT DROP
